chunks: Ibn Mahbub, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Sinan, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام:
Concerning a man upon whom several prescribed punishments had become due, among them killing, he said: “One begins with the punishments that are less than killing, then he is killed afterward.”

key_terms.الْقَتْلُ: execution or killing as a legal punishment
key_terms.حُدُودٌ: prescribed legal punishments established in the Sacred Law
key_terms.دُونَ: less than or below in degree

ai.seo_question: If a person is subject to multiple hudud punishments including execution, which punishment is carried out first?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person liable for multiple prescribed punishments, one of which is execution. It states that the lesser hudud penalties are carried out first, and then the execution is performed afterward.
